gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 identifies the same failed fixed-R asymptotic claim: mesh refinement leaves the upper endpoint at the finite-radius Dirichlet eigenvalue and the lower endpoint with the finite-radius Neumann correction, so truncation and the correction do not vanish without R tending to infinity.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both entries diagnose the false assertion that h-refinement alone makes the finite-radius enclosure converge to the whole-space eigenvalue; the finite-R truncation error and h-independent lower-bound correction remain.

component_coverage.gold_component: The claimed fixed-R mesh-refinement convergence of both enclosure endpoints to the whole-space eigenvalue is false because the upper endpoint retains finite-radius truncation and the lower endpoint retains the exterior correction.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly states fixed R, gives the finite-radius limits of both endpoints, identifies the persistent correction and truncation effects, and states that convergence to lambda_k requires R to tend to infinity as well.
